note: Sanitized field-selected snapshots, not original audit files. Local absolute paths, raw source lists and giant output registries are omitted. Original file hashes are preserved below and in provenance.json.

teammate_corrections.scope: Independent same-input correction grids, hashes and arithmetic; no raw re-matching by this final auditor.

limitations: Independent event matching checks sample each directed pair/side; they do not re-match every raw event.
Date-block intervals are marginal exploratory estimates; they are not multiplicity-adjusted or causal effects.
Twenty sessions contain roughly four nonoverlapping five-session blocks; interval precision remains approximate.

multi_year_events.scope: Local source-byte/metadata/receipt, availability quarantine, frozen-draw, checkpoint, full-grid, arithmetic and descriptive-statistics audit; no API or credential access and no second full native DBN reconstruction.

stationarity.scope: All persisted run identities, paired ADF/KPSS numeric results/warnings/classifications, global Holm values and summaries; all input/output/source hashes and existing source-study audit binding; independent native selection only for the named source-group sample.
